Average
Nov 2022 • Couples
I was very dissapointed with our dinner here. My husband ordered a pork burrito and the filling resembled baby food, juat mushy and hard to tell if there was actual meat in there. I was looking forward to my chilli bowl, especially as my husband's food had already come and been consumed by the time it arrived - and no it wasn't busy, we were the first ones in there for dinner before anyone else showed up.
The bowl of chilli that arrived was quite frankly pitiful, I wondered if i had ordered a starter or side dish by mistake the bowl was so small, and forget it being hot, it was barely warm. The only good thing o can say was their tortilla chips that went with the chilli were nice and crispy. To top it off they charged us full price for the seinka instead of the happy hour prices, wouldn't have quibbled over the bill if the food had actually been good. Will stick to hanoi taco bar in future for sure!!
